description: This week, the General Assembly returned to Nashville for a special session focused on congressional redistricting.I want to be clear from the beginning: good people can look at the same facts and come to different conclusions. I respect my colleagues who voted differently than I did. My vote was not a statement against them. It was a reflection of my concerns about the timing, the process, and the long-term consequences of redrawing congressional districts mid-decade. As your representative, I
